latest_cos_commentary.headline: Savi is a video/audio AI analytics platform for multi-unit restaurant drive-thrus, using existing camera infrastructure to measure and improve speed-of-service by lane stage.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Overlaps with Genius's kitchen_drive_thru analytics capabilities on drive-thru speed-of-service measurement rather than POS or payments; positions itself as a camera-based analytics add-on rather than a POS replacement.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Actively publishing drive-thru research (e.g., drive-thru sentiment/review-score studies) to support its analytics positioning; no funding or ownership news identified in this pass.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: If a prospect already has cameras and is evaluating drive-thru timing analytics, note that Savi's pitch is add-on analytics on existing hardware rather than a POS/payments replacement.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Public evidence is limited to one named case study (Swig); leadership, funding, and company scale were not confirmed in sourced materials.
